$comment: DOE ZONE MODEL — shared contract vectors.
Consumed by contracts/doe_band_rules/client_harness.mjs (node, read-only over
client2/src/{doe_bands.js,tsv.js,transfer_plan.js}). The server side lands against this
same file, which is the point: a rule that lives in one language drifts.
WHAT REPLACED WHAT (2026-07-28). The band model (rows with FROM->TO, a value-set scope,
`seq` identity) is retired. A value now carries ONE number and THREE zones:
STACK = total layers | 1H = layer 1 | TOP = layer STACK | MID = everything between
MID zone = (1H present ? 2 : 1) .. (TOP present ? STACK-1 : STACK)
DELETED VECTOR GROUPS, and why each one could not be translated rather than moved:
* expansion_cases  — `expandBandValues`, `ALL`, `B,C`. A zone belongs to exactly one
value BY POSITION; there is no by-name reference from a layer range to a value set,
so there is nothing to expand and B4 (naming an undefined value) has no referent.
* span_cases       — `bandLayerSpan(from,to)`. Replaced 1:1 by zone_extent_cases,
which pins the same question (`which layers does this cover, or is it unknowable`)
against the geometry that actually exists now. Coverage moved; it was not dropped.
* rename_cases     — `remapBandValues`. Renaming a value used to orphan the bands that
referenced it by name. Zones live IN the value's own row, so a rename carries them
for free and there is no propagation left to get wrong.
* the B1/B2/B5/B6/B9 plan cases — FROM>TO, FROM<1, overlap, gap, a band scoped to no
value. These were not relaxed: the three zones TILE `1..STACK` by construction, so
those states are UNSTATEABLE. B9's hazard is the one that survived translation and
is now V5 — see stack_cases.$why.
CARRIED OVER BYTE FOR BYTE: material_token_cases and remaining_cases. The token grammar
and the 3-state availability rule were settled with the user and say nothing about
whether layers are described by bands or by zones.
`expect_blocks` / `expect_warns` are SETS of rule ids (order-independent).

stack_cases.$why: 🔴 THE RULE THAT CARRIES B9's HAZARD ACROSS THE REWRITE. The band model derived a value's height from its COVERED layers, so an unassigned top range simply LOWERED max and every other rule passed - a 16-layer stack silently became 15. Zones do not derive the height; STACK states it. That closes the hole only while STACK is READABLE: an unreadable STACK treated as 0, or skipped, reproduces the identical defect behind a screen that looks fine. So it is invalid, it blocks, and it blocks FIRST. STACK 0 (2026-07-28, user): an EXPLICIT 0 is a fourth state, `marker` - the value paints a CONDITION (e.g. BASE FAIL), not a layer assignment. It has no zones, no demand, no rollup row, and the V-rules leave it alone (V6 reports the one contradiction: a marker with zone content). Blank is NOT merged into it - blank is absence, 0 is a declaration.

stack_cases.name: one_is_a_legal_height
stack_cases.$why: dt_map. The degenerate case is not the invalid case.

stack_cases.name: whitespace_is_blank_not_zero
stack_cases.$why: `Number('  ')` is 0. A height of 0 makes every zone empty and every other rule pass. Under the marker semantics this matters MORE, not less: coercing whitespace to 0 would silently turn a half-typed row into a declared marker.

stack_cases.name: zero_is_a_marker_not_a_height
stack_cases.$why: 🔴 THE U9 RULE. 0 is not invalid and not blank - it is the user saying 'this value marks a state'. An implementation that keeps refusing 0, or that folds it into blank, fails here.

stack_cases.name: zero_string_is_a_marker_too
stack_cases.$why: Excel delivers text. The same judge that reads '16' as 16 must read '0' as the marker.

stack_cases.name: negative_is_not_a_height
stack_cases.$why: Only EXACTLY 0 is the marker. -3 is still a typo, not a declaration.

stack_cases.name: hex_string_is_not_16
stack_cases.$why: `Number('0x10')` is 16. Reading it that way once wrote 16 into the DB for text the user had typed.

zone_extent_cases.$why: The whole geometry. A fixture in which every row carried all three zones would let a bug in the `has1H ? 2 : 1` branch pass every case, so rows with 1H ABSENT and rows with TOP ABSENT are both present and are the only place those branches are exercised.

zone_extent_cases.name: no_1h_so_mid_starts_at_one
zone_extent_cases.$why: An implementation that hardcoded MID's start at 2 passes every all-three-present case and fails only here.

zone_extent_cases.name: no_top_so_mid_runs_to_stack
zone_extent_cases.$why: The mirror of the case above. Hardcoding MID's end at STACK-1 fails only here.

zone_extent_cases.name: stack_two_with_both_ends_leaves_a_zero_layer_mid
zone_extent_cases.$why: 🔴 `size: 0` with `known: true` is NOT the same as unknown. This row is CORRECT and must not block. `from > to` is deliberate - the extent is empty, and clamping it to `from == to` would invent a layer.

zone_extent_cases.name: unreadable_stack_makes_every_extent_unknowable
zone_extent_cases.$why: 🔴 `zoneLayers` returns null, never []. An unreadable height that silently contributed zero layers is how a 16-layer stack becomes 15 - `[]` here would be indistinguishable from the legitimate E-row above.

zone_extent_cases.name: marker_stack_zero_has_no_zones_by_construction
zone_extent_cases.$why: 🔴 THE MIRROR OF THE ROW ABOVE, AND THE TWO MUST NOT COLLAPSE. A marker's extents are KNOWN and EMPTY ([] / known:true - like the E-row, a real zero), while an unreadable height is UNKNOWABLE (null / known:false). Fold marker into unreadable and V5 nags at a legal row; fold unreadable into marker and a typo'd height silently demands nothing behind a clean screen. The MID material here is deliberate: even with content typed in, the extent stays [] - the contradiction is V6's to report, not the geometry's to legitimize.

plan_cases.$why: Five blocking rules replaced ten, plus V6 for markers. V5 STACK unreadable | V2 STACK 1 with both ends | V1 MID missing while its zone is non-empty | V4 unreadable material token | V3 whole lot + one of its own slots in one BIN | V6 marker (STACK 0) with zone content. All are advisory in the same way: they land next to the row, they do not gate the save.

plan_cases.name: dt_map_plan_is_silent
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 THE DEGENERATE CASE MUST NOT BE NAGGED AT. A validator that complains about its own degenerate case teaches people to ignore it, and then they ignore the one that matters.

plan_cases.name: empty_mid_zone_passes_with_no_mid
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 V1 IS CONDITIONAL AND THIS IS THE ONLY CASE THAT PROVES IT. An unconditional `MID required` passes every other plan case in this file and fails here.

plan_cases.name: non_empty_mid_zone_with_no_mid_blocks
plan_cases.$why: MID zone is 1-15 here. Fifteen layers with nothing on them.

plan_cases.name: stack_one_with_both_ends_blocks
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 PAIRED WITH THE E-ROW ABOVE, WHICH IS THE SAME SHAPE ONE LAYER TALLER AND PASSES. One layer decides pass vs block. And MID is NOT a reason here - its zone is 0 layers - so V1 must stay silent, or the message sends the user to the one cell that is innocent.

plan_cases.name: unreadable_stack_blocks_and_suppresses_the_extent_rules
plan_cases.$why: V1 must NOT also fire: its zone cannot be computed, and two contradictory messages about one row is worse than one.

plan_cases.name: blank_stack_blocks_too
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 UNCHANGED BY U9, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Blank is 'not typed yet' and still blocks; 0 is a declaration and passes. An implementation that reads blank as 0 turns every half-typed row into a marker and this case is the only one that catches it.

plan_cases.name: marker_row_alone_is_silent
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 THE U9 CONTRACT. STACK 0 = 상태 표시 값 (e.g. BASE FAIL): painted cells state a condition, not a layer assignment. V5 must NOT fire - a validator that nags at a declared marker teaches people to ignore it. And V1 must not fire either: a marker has no MID zone to be missing.

plan_cases.name: marker_with_zone_content_reports_the_contradiction
plan_cases.$why: A value with no layers cannot carry materials - one of the two statements is wrong, and only the user knows which. V6 REPORTS (advisory, like every rule since the save stopped gating on validation); it does not silently drop the materials, because they may be the half the user meant to keep.

plan_cases.name: marker_contradiction_is_the_only_message_on_that_row
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 V4 MUST NOT ALSO FIRE. The token 'ABC_' is unreadable, but on a marker row no token will ever be looked up or demanded - reporting V4 next to V6 gives two contradictory instructions about one row (fix the token vs remove the materials). Same suppression pattern as V5-suppresses-V1.

plan_cases.name: marker_materials_do_not_participate_in_V3
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 THE CONTROL FOR V6's EXEMPTION SCOPE. Without the marker row this plan is clean; the marker's 'MID1' demands nothing, so pairing it with A's 'MID1_03' as a V3 double-count would block a plan over wafers nobody is asking for. V6 already names the real problem.

plan_cases.name: unreadable_material_token_blocks
plan_cases.$why: It cannot be looked up, so its availability could only ever be reported as 0 - and 0 reads as 'all consumed' when the truth is 'we never resolved it'.

plan_cases.name: whole_lot_plus_its_own_slot_same_bin_blocks
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 A PROPERTY OF THE WHOLE PLAN, NOT OF A ROW PAIR. The two tokens are on DIFFERENT VALUES here on purpose: a per-row implementation passes this, and the double-counted wafers show up as a shortage at the worst moment.

plan_cases.name: same_lot_different_bin_is_a_different_pool
plan_cases.$why: 🔴 THE CONTROL FOR V3. An implementation that ignored BIN blocks this correct plan.

plan_cases.name: duplicate_within_one_zone_warns_but_saves
plan_cases.$why: A duplicate changes the denominator of `ceil(total / n)` for no reason.

plan_cases.name: same_material_in_two_zones_is_legitimate
plan_cases.$why: The control for W-DUP-MAT. The same lot at the bottom and in the middle is two demands on different layers.

plan_cases.name: several_defects_are_all_reported
plan_cases.$why: The panel names every reason on its own row; stopping at the first would make the user fix them one reload at a time.

material_token_cases.$why: CARRIED OVER FROM THE BAND MODEL UNCHANGED. The grammar was settled with the user; whether layers are bands or zones says nothing about how a material is named.

material_token_cases.name: bare_lot_means_the_whole_lot
material_token_cases.$why: ⚠️ REVERSES `splitMaterialId`'s refusal, and exactly one case changes. That function says 'never guess' for a separator-less id; under THIS grammar a bare name is not unresolvable, it MEANS the whole lot. Every genuinely malformed token below still refuses.

material_token_cases.name: slot_with_explicit_bin
material_token_cases.$why: 🔴 THIS IS WHY IDENTITY CANNOT COME FROM `splitMaterialId` ANY MORE. That function splits on the last `_`, so it reads slot `01:3` here and asks the server about a slot that does not exist - a confident 0 for a material that is fine.

material_token_cases.name: colon_splits_from_the_right
material_token_cases.$why: A lot name may legitimately contain a colon.

material_token_cases.name: dangling_underscore_refuses
material_token_cases.$why: A typo, not a scope. Reading it as 'the whole lot ABC' would be the guess this grammar refuses to make.

material_token_cases.name: hex_bin_refuses
material_token_cases.$why: Same integer reader as STACK. A second number parser is how '0x10' became 16 on one side and 0 on the other.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_separates_lot_scope_from_a_slot_literally_named_null
material_token_cases.$why: `null` (whole lot) must be structurally distinct from the string 'null'. Joining on a separator cannot express that.

material_token_cases.name: pool_key_does_not_collide_across_underscore_boundaries
material_token_cases.$why: 🔴 THE REAL INCIDENT. An earlier version joined on U+001F, the control characters were dropped on write, and both of these produced 'MID1123'. Two unrelated pools merged into one rollup row and their 사용 was summed.

demand_cases.$why: 구역 총 소요 = 칠한 셀 수 × 층 수 · 자재당 = ceil(총 소요 / 그 구역의 자재 수).

demand_cases.name: ceiling_not_rounding_and_not_flooring
demand_cases.$why: 🔴 5/4. Rounding and flooring both give 1 and both hide a shortfall. A plan that quietly under-orders is worse than one that over-orders - and this is the exact shape of the incident where saving used ceil, display used round, and the DB held 34 while the screen said 33.

demand_cases.name: unreadable_stack_demands_nothing
demand_cases.$why: V5 has already blocked the plan. What must NOT happen is a plausible non-zero number derived from a height nobody could read.

demand_cases.name: unpainted_value_demands_nothing_but_still_has_layers
demand_cases.$why: 층 수는 그대로 16이다 — 구조는 있고 그림이 없을 뿐이다.

demand_cases.name: marker_value_demands_nothing_however_much_is_painted
demand_cases.$why: 🔴 The painted count is the MESSAGE (96 cells are in that state), not a multiplier. A marker whose painted cells produced demand would order material for a condition - and 96 cells x anything is exactly the plausible-looking wrong number this file exists to forbid.

rollup_cases.$why: 행의 정체는 풀 (lot, slot, BIN)이지 자재 이름이 아니다.

rollup_cases.name: one_material_across_two_values_and_two_zones
rollup_cases.$why: ADFE1H_01: B의 1H(64×1) + E의 1H(40×1) = 104. 서로 다른 값의 서로 다른 구역이 한 풀에 합쳐진다 — 그것이 ②가 존재하는 이유다. 두 값의 painted를 일부러 다르게(64/40) 두었다: 같으면 엉뚱한 값의 수를 쓰는 결함이 나타나지 않는다.

rollup_cases.name: bin_is_part_of_the_identity
rollup_cases.$why: 🔴 두 행이어야 한다. BIN을 접으면 한 행에 26이 되고 잔여가 이유 없이 낮게 나온다.

rollup_cases.name: whole_lot_and_a_slot_are_different_pools
rollup_cases.$why: V3 blocks this plan, and the rollup still has to SHOW both rows - that is where the user sees the two tokens side by side and fixes it. total 6×2층=12, 자재 2개 -> 각 6.

rollup_cases.name: unreadable_token_is_not_a_row_but_still_counts_in_the_denominator
rollup_cases.$why: V4 blocks the save. Here it must not become a row with a fabricated identity - but the DENOMINATOR still counts it (10/2 = 5), because the user typed two materials and silently re-dividing by one would change a number they can see.

rollup_cases.name: marker_row_is_absent_from_the_rollup_entirely
rollup_cases.$why: 🔴 ABSENT, not present-with-zero. A 'MID9 · 사용 0' row would read as 'this material is planned and costs nothing', invite an availability query for it, and grow the rollup by one row per marker. The marker's materials are a V6 contradiction, not a demand - table ② must not launder them into inventory. F's painted 50 is deliberately larger than A's 6 so a rollup that counts the marker cannot hide.

remaining_cases.$why: CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED. 잔여 must NEVER be a number when 가용 is not trustworthy: `0` reads as 'all consumed' when the truth may be 'that BIN does not exist' or 'we could not ask'.

remaining_cases.name: negative_remainder_is_still_a_number
remaining_cases.$why: 부족은 숨기지 않는다 — 음수가 곧 부족의 크기다.

remaining_cases.name: server_degraded_is_not_zero
remaining_cases.$why: 🔴 서버가 숫자를 줬는데도 숨긴다. 강등된 값을 확정값처럼 보이면 계획이 틀린다.

tsv_cases.$why: 🔴 EXCEL'S QUOTING RULES, WHICH THE PREVIOUS INLINE PARSER DID NOT HAVE. A `split('\n')` breaks ONE cell into TWO records the moment a cell holds two lines - and a MID cell with two materials is exactly that shape. Pinned here because client2/src/tsv.js is now shared with the grid's Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V.

tsv_cases.name: trailing_newline_is_not_a_row
tsv_cases.$why: Excel always ends its clipboard block with one.

tsv_cases.name: empty_text_is_no_rows
tsv_cases.$why: One empty row here would blank a value's fields.

tsv_cases.name: empty_cells_are_kept
tsv_cases.$why: An empty 1H is DATA - it means MID starts at layer 1. Dropping it shifts every column after it.

tsv_cases.name: quoted_newline_stays_one_cell
tsv_cases.$why: 🔴 THE CASE THIS PARSER EXISTS FOR.

tsv_cases.name: a_quote_mid_field_is_literal
tsv_cases.$why: Excel only treats a quote as an opener at the START of a field.

$why: 🔴 THE ROSTER ITSELF, not a sample of it. `paste_cases` walks three of these words;
walking words proves each word works and proves NOTHING about the SET. A fourth entry
(`COUNT`) was added to `IGNORED_HEADERS` on 2026-07-29 and every one of the 331
assertions stayed green, because a harness only scores the vectors it has. That is the
hole this key closes: compare the SET, not the count.
IT HAS SINCE FIRED FOR REAL. On 2026-07-30 the roster went 4 → 13 and this key was the
ONE assertion of 362 that diverged. That divergence is the receipt: the key is not
decorative, and nothing else in the contract noticed nine new words.
WHAT A ROSTER ENTRY COSTS. A word in here is a word `columnIdByHeader` answers `IGNORE`
for, which means two things at once: (a) `looksLikeHeader` accepts a heading row
containing it instead of pasting that row AS DATA, and (b) its column is dropped. So an
entry added by accident silently DELETES a column of the user's paste, and an entry
removed by accident silently turns a heading row into a value literally named 'VALUE'.
Neither shows up on screen. Both are why this is a set assertion and not a review item.
WHERE EACH WORD COMES FROM — every one is a word THIS APP PUTS ON A SURFACE A HUMAN
SELECTS. None of them was taken from the parser; the parser is the thing being scored.
① THE DOE IDENTITY LINE (4 words) — the panel's own row.
COLOR  — the colour cell of that line. App-owned (user directive 2026-07-28): Excel's
cell fill does not travel in `text/plain`, so it comes back blank or as noise
and must never be read as data.
칠함   — the painted-cell count on that same line. Derived from the grid, so accepting
it would let a pasted number overwrite a count the user cannot author.
칠함*  — THE SAME COLUMN AS RENDERED BY THE RETIRED HEADER ROW. `transfer_plan.js`
drew `칠함*` in `tp-ch-row l1` from b35bc9f until
the header row was deleted for readability (7694b42). The word outlives the
row: sheets transcribed from that panel still carry the asterisk.
COLOR* — the same retired row's OTHER asterisked word, added 2026-07-30 by Lead PM
ruling. Same rendered row, same commit, same asterisk as `칠함*`; the sole
justification for keeping `칠함*` holds identically for it. See `$resolved`.
⚠️ BOTH ASTERISKED ENTRIES ARE BACK-COMPAT ONLY. Measured 2026-07-30: no asterisked
header string is rendered anywhere in `client2/src` — the only surviving mentions
are this roster, its own comment, and a CSS comment in `transfer_plan.css`. They
exist for old exports and hand-made sheets, not for anything on screen today.
② THE EXPORT FORM (1 word).
COUNT  — the export name of the 칠함 value. `map_editor.js` builds the right-hand aux
table's heading as `[colHeaderWord('value'), 'COUNT', colHeaderWord('stack'),
colHeaderWord('desc')]` (see `auxHead`, next to `copyHeaderAuxRows`) — the
user's company bonding-map form. WE EMIT IT, so we must read it back; see
`a_header_naming_COUNT_is_ignored_too`.
③ THE MATERIAL ROLLUP PANEL ② (8 words, added 2026-07-30) — the UNION of two forms of
the same header, which is why it is eight and not six:
the GRID form  `ROLLUP_COLUMNS` in doe_bands.js, emitted by `rollupToGrid`:
MAT · BIN · MAP · 가용 · 사용 · 잔여        (six)
the RENDERED form  `tp-ch-row` in transfer_plan.js, what a human actually selects:
MAT · MAP · 가용 · 사용≈ · 잔여≈           (five — no BIN column on screen)
`사용≈`/`잔여≈` are carried as their own entries because the panel draws
`사용≈`, so plain-text selection delivers `사용≈` as ONE run.
A judge that folds case and outer whitespace does not strip that symbol, and starting
to strip it here would invent a second normalisation rule. `가용` is rendered WITHOUT
the `≈` (measured), which is why `가용≈` sits in `never_ignored` — it is the word that
kills a `≈`-stripping normaliser.
⚠️ THESE EIGHT ARE PREPARATORY. THEY BUY NOTHING TODAY. Measured 2026-07-30:
· `rollupToGrid` is defined and exported in `doe_bands.js` and has ZERO importers
across `client2/src`, `client2/tests` and `contracts/`. The ②→① round trip its
own comment declares as design intent ('a copied ② can be pasted into ①') IS NOT
WIRED. The harness scores that importer count, so the day someone wires it this
contract goes red pointing at this paragraph — which is the point.
· map-pm measured that a browser SELECTION of the on-screen ② header emits no tab
separators between the flex spans, so hand-copying that row lands as a single
cell regardless of what this roster says.
They were kept because the declared intent is real and the cost is bounded (below).
DO NOT READ THIS ROSTER AS EVIDENCE THAT THE ②→① PATH WORKS. It does not, yet.
THE COST OF THE NINE NEW WORDS, BOUNDED BY MEASUREMENT (2026-07-30). Every roster word
widens `looksLikeHeader`, and `MAT`/`MAP`/`BIN` are plausible lot names. But the
predicate requires EVERY non-empty cell to resolve to a known column, with a two-cell
floor — so a false positive needs a paste in which *every* cell is a roster or contract
word, not merely one. A realistic DOE data row carries a numeric STACK, which resolves
to null and breaks the match at that one cell. `header_row_boundary` pins that bound so
it stays a measured claim rather than a remembered one; see `$residual` for what the
bound does NOT cover.
`never_ignored` is the half that stops the roster from being satisfied by an
implementation that answers `IGNORE` too readily. The load-bearing entries are the
UNKNOWN words: if an unrecognised word returned `IGNORE` instead of `null`, every
two-column paste of ordinary data would be mistaken for a heading and the user's FIRST
DATA ROW would be eaten. Each entry names the wrong implementation it kills:
COUNTS · 칠                     substring / prefix matching (the original pair)
MATERIAL · MAPPING · BINNING    `startsWith` against MAT/MAP/BIN — the ASCII rollup
words are short, which is exactly why this matters
사용중 · 잔여량                  `startsWith` on the Korean side
SUBMAT · REMAP                  `includes` rather than equality
칠함** · COLOR**                 stripping trailing asterisks during normalisation —
now that BOTH `칠함*` and `COLOR*` are members, only a
doubled asterisk can still catch that
가용≈                           stripping the `≈` symbol during normalisation. 가용 is
the one rollup word the panel renders WITHOUT it, so
`가용≈` is a word this app never emits
0 · '' · '   '                  a numeric or blank cell is never a header word. STACK
0 is a LEGAL declared value in this contract (v3
marker semantics), so a row carrying it stays data.

header_row_boundary.$why: The roster's PURPOSE, in the positive direction: the rendered ② header row (`tp-ch-row`) must be recognised as a heading, or a user who selects it and pastes into ① gets a data row named 'MAT'. This is the case the eight rollup words were added FOR — it is the vector that would have to be deleted, not merely edited, to justify removing them.
The other form of the same header — `ROLLUP_COLUMNS`, the grid `rollupToGrid` emits. Both forms must be readable or the round trip is one-directional. Note `BIN` appears here and not on screen.

🔴 THE COST BOUND. One roster word beside a numeric STACK is NOT a heading. This is the vector that keeps the nine new words cheap: it dies the moment `looksLikeHeader` is loosened from 'every cell resolves' to 'any cell resolves', which is the plausible refactor that would turn a widened roster into silent data loss.
Same bound with a roster word buried mid-row rather than leading, so the check cannot be satisfied by only inspecting the first cell.
The two-cell floor. A one-column paste of a lot literally named `MAT` is data, not a heading. Without the floor every single-cell paste of a roster word would vanish.
Contract columns may not repeat even though `IGNORE` may. Two VALUE cells are a malformed heading, and reading them as one would drop a column silently.

$resolved: ✅ RULED BY LEAD PM, 2026-07-30. Recorded here with the question as it was asked, because
a reader who finds only the answer cannot tell whether the asymmetry was considered or
never noticed.
THE QUESTION AS ASKED (contract-keeper, 2026-07-29). The retired header row rendered TWO
asterisked words, and only one of them was on the roster:
COLOR* ← NOT a member
칠함* ← member
If a user pastes a heading row carrying `COLOR*`, `columnIdByHeader` answers null,
`looksLikeHeader` refuses, and the heading lands as a data row named 'COLOR*' — the exact
failure the COUNT entry was added to prevent. No vector pinned either answer,
deliberately: pinning the then-current behaviour would have made a suspected defect into
the contract, and pinning the other would have left this file red for something the
contract-keeper does not own.
THE RULING — `IGNORED_HEADERS` holds 13 entries. Three grounds, all of them decisions:
ⓐ `COLOR*` IS ADDED. Same rendered row, same commit (`tp-ch-row l1`, b35bc9f, deleted
in 7694b42), same asterisk as `칠함*`. The sole justification for keeping `칠함*` —
old exports and hand-made sheets still carry the word — holds identically for
`COLOR*`. Having one and not the other was an unjustified asymmetry. Both entries
are back-compat only: the app renders no asterisked header anywhere today.
ⓑ THE EIGHT ② ROLLUP WORDS ARE ADDED, AND THEY ARE PREPARATORY. `rollupToGrid` has
zero importers and the ②→① round trip its comment declares is not wired; a browser
selection of the on-screen ② header produces no tab separators either. They buy
nothing today. They were kept because the cost is near-zero (ⓒ) and the declared
intent is real — but the contract says PREPARATORY out loud so that no future
reader takes the roster as evidence that the path works. See `$why` ③.
ⓒ THE COST IS BOUNDED BY MEASUREMENT, NOT BY ASSERTION. map-pm flagged that every
roster word widens `looksLikeHeader` and named MAT/MAP/BIN as plausible lot names.
Lead PM measured the predicate: EVERY non-empty cell must resolve to a known
column, with a two-cell floor. A realistic DOE row carries a numeric STACK, which
returns null and breaks the match at that one cell. The false positive therefore
requires a paste in which *every* cell is a roster or contract word — not merely
one. The risk is real but far narrower than 'nine more words widen it'.
`header_row_boundary` is where that bound now lives as a scored vector.
$residual: ⚠️ WHAT THE RULING DOES NOT COVER — recorded, not pinned. Neither answer is written into
a vector, because pinning today's behaviour would make a suspected gap into the contract
and pinning the other would leave this file red for something the contract-keeper does
not own. Both are measurements, 2026-07-30, on the live extracted predicate.
① AN ALL-ROSTER TWO-COLUMN PASTE IS STILL EATEN. `looksLikeHeader(['MAT','BIN'])` is
true — every cell resolves and `IGNORE` is allowed to repeat. `mapPastedGrid` then
returns `{header: true, columns: ['IGNORE','IGNORE'], rows: [{}]}`, so a two-column
paste whose first row happens to be two lot names drawn from the roster does
NOTHING AT ALL — the data rows come back as empty patches. The shape pre-dates the
ruling (`['COLOR','칠함']` behaved the same way), but ⓒ widens which word pairs
trigger it from two app-owned words to eleven. Failure mode is silent no-op, not
corruption. A future ruling could pin it by requiring at least one NON-ignored
contract column in a heading row.
② INNER WHITESPACE IS NOT FOLDED. `columnIdByHeader('사용 ≈')` is null while
`columnIdByHeader(' 사용≈ ')` is IGNORE. The design note in `doe_bands.js` commits
to folding 'case and whitespace' without saying whether that means trim or collapse,
so the contract scores the trim reading only (` 사용≈ `) and leaves the collapse
reading unpinned. If a real clipboard path is ever observed delivering `사용 ≈`,
this is the line to come back to.

paste_cases.$why: ㉠ 머리줄이 있으면 이름으로 · ㉡ 없으면 포커스한 칸의 논리 인덱스부터 왼→오른쪽 · ㉢ 거절은 없다. 계약은 여섯 열 — VALUE·STACK·DESC·1H·MID·TOP. 계약 밖 낱말은 `ignored_headers.members`가 **정본**이다 — 그 수와 철자를 여기에 다시 적지 않는다(손으로 쓴 요약은 리스트의 두 번째 사본이고, 실제로 로스터가 4→13으로 늘었을 때 낡았다). 계약 밖이지만 **머리줄에서는 알아본다**(사람은 화면의 머리줄을, 또는 자기가 내보낸 표를 통째로 긁는다). 아래 케이스는 그중 셋만 밟는다. 집합 자체는 `ignored_headers`가 단언한다 — 케이스를 세지 말고 집합을 비교하라.

paste_cases.name: a_header_naming_COLOR_is_still_a_header_and_the_column_is_dropped
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 IF THE PARSER DID NOT RECOGNISE `COLOR`, `looksLikeHeader` would reject this record and the whole heading row would be pasted AS DATA - producing a value literally named 'COLOR'. Recognised-and-ignored is not the same as unknown.

paste_cases.name: a_header_naming_칠함_is_ignored_too
paste_cases.$why: 파생값이다. 받으면 사용자가 칠 수 없는 수를 사용자의 입력이 덮는다.

paste_cases.name: a_header_naming_COUNT_is_ignored_too
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 왕복이다. 이 네 낱말은 우리가 **내보낸** 것이다 — map_editor의 COPY HEADER MODE가 우측 보조표 머리줄을 `[VALUE, 'COUNT', STACK, DESC]`로 싣는다(`copyHeaderAuxRows` 옆의 `auxHead`, 사용자 회사 본딩맵 양식). 기댓값의 출처는 파서가 아니라 **그 내보내기**다. COUNT를 모르면 `looksLikeHeader`가 이 행을 거절하고, 사용자가 자기가 내보낸 표를 DOE 패널에 되붙이는 순간 머리줄이 **데이터 행이 된다** — 값 이름이 문자 그대로 'VALUE'이고 STACK이 'COUNT'인 행. 알아보되 **버린다**: 칠한 셀 수는 격자에서 세는 것이지 붙여넣기로 정하는 것이 아니다. 나머지 세 낱말이 계약 열이므로 이 케이스는 '무시'가 '열 하나 삭제'로 잘못 구현된 경우도 함께 떨어뜨린다 — DESC가 STACK 자리로 밀리면 expect가 어긋난다.

paste_cases.name: header_in_any_order
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 THE ACCIDENT THIS PREVENTS: the same three columns pasted positionally from VALUE would put MID into VALUE, VALUE into STACK and STACK into DESC - and nothing on screen would look wrong.

paste_cases.name: headerless_fills_from_the_focused_column
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 논리 인덱스지 '화면에서 오른쪽 칸'이 아니다. 한 행이 두 줄로 그려지므로 그 둘은 다르다.

paste_cases.name: headerless_leading_blank_colour_column_is_skipped_not_shifted
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 THE COLOUR COLUMN THE USER STILL HAS IN EXCEL. Cell fill does not travel through `text/plain`, so a coloured-but-empty column arrives as a leading blank field and taking it literally puts VALUE into STACK. Four conditions must ALL hold: no header, start is VALUE, the first field is blank in EVERY record (a column property, not a row guess), and the block is WIDER than the contract.

paste_cases.name: exactly_six_wide_with_a_blank_first_field_is_NOT_shifted
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 THE GUARD ON THE RULE ABOVE. Six fields already fit the contract, so dropping one WOULD be the silent shift we are preventing. The honest reading is 'VALUE is blank' - a value with no name cannot exist, so the row shows up empty on screen immediately. Refusing to shift beats being clever.

paste_cases.name: a_blank_first_field_in_only_some_rows_is_data_not_a_colour_column
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 IT IS A COLUMN PROPERTY. One blank cell is data; a blank in every row is a column. Checking only the first record would drop a real VALUE from the second.

paste_cases.name: leading_blank_is_not_skipped_when_the_start_is_not_VALUE
paste_cases.$why: An empty 1H is meaningful data - it means MID starts at layer 1. The colour column can only ever precede VALUE.

paste_cases.name: cells_past_the_last_column_are_counted_not_silently_dropped
paste_cases.$why: 무시하는 것은 맞지만 **몇 개를 무시했는지 말해야** 한다. 조용히 버리면 사용자는 다 들어간 줄 안다.

paste_cases.name: a_single_word_that_names_a_column_is_not_a_header
paste_cases.$why: 🔴 `MID`는 완벽하게 합법적인 lot 이름이다. 머리줄 판정에 '두 칸 이상' 바닥이 없으면 사용자의 자재가 머리줄로 먹힌다.

roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 THE USER'S ACTUAL REQUIREMENT, and the one thing a unit test of the parser alone will not catch. 엑셀에서 뚝딱 만든 표를 붙여넣고, 고치고, 다시 복사해 엑셀로 돌아갈 수 있어야 한다. `tsv` -> parse -> mapPastedGrid -> legend rows -> planToGrid -> serialize must equal `expect_tsv` (default: `tsv` itself).

roundtrip_cases.name: canonical_block_survives_paste_then_copy
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
A	8	게이트 산화		MID2	TOP1
B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	"MID1
MID3"	TOP1
DT	1	DT 맵		DTM4_11
roundtrip_cases.$why: 세 행이 각각 다른 축을 켠다: A는 1H 비움, B는 MID에 자재 둘(엑셀 따옴표), DT는 퇴화형. 한 행짜리 픽스처는 열 어긋남도 따옴표도 증명하지 못한다.

roundtrip_cases.name: a_colour_column_in_the_source_does_not_survive_the_trip
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
COLOR	VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
#2f7d63	B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	MID1	TOP1
roundtrip_cases.expect_tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	MID1	TOP1
roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 COLOUR IS APP-OWNED (사용자 지시 2026-07-28). It is read out of the paste by name and never emitted, so the second trip is an identity.

roundtrip_cases.name: comma_input_is_accepted_and_normalizes_to_newline
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	MID1, MID3	TOP1
roundtrip_cases.expect_tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	"MID1
MID3"	TOP1
roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 NOT AN IDENTITY ROUND TRIP, AND THAT IS THE POINT. 쉼표는 **받는** 입력이고 줄바꿈은 **내보내는** 형태다. 쉼표로 내보내면 lot 이름에 쉼표가 든 날 한 토큰이 둘로 쪼개진다. 두 번째 왕복부터는 항등이어야 한다(하네스가 두 번 돈다).

roundtrip_cases.name: unreadable_stack_round_trips_as_typed
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
X	0x10			M_01
roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 복사가 고쳐서 내보내면 안 된다. 왕복의 요점은 있는 그대로 돌려주어 사용자가 엑셀에서 고치는 것이다 — 16으로 '수리'해 내보내면 사용자가 친 적 없는 값이 계획이 된다.

roundtrip_cases.name: inapplicable_zone_exports_as_an_empty_cell
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
DT	1			DTM4_11
roundtrip_cases.$why: 「해당 없음」은 렌더링이다. 글자로 내보내면 다시 붙여넣을 수 없는 표가 된다.

roundtrip_cases.name: whole_lot_exports_as_the_raw_token_not_the_chip
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
B	4			MID1
roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 칩은 그림이다. `MID1_✱:1`을 내보내면 `_✱`라는 슬롯을 가진 로트가 생긴다.

roundtrip_cases.name: a_desc_containing_a_tab_is_quoted_and_comes_back_whole
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
B	4	"a	b"		M_01
roundtrip_cases.$why: 종전 직렬화기는 탭을 공백으로 **바꿔** 내보냈다 — 조용한 데이터 손실이고, 복사한 칸을 다시 붙여넣어도 같은 칸이 나오지 않던 이유다.

roundtrip_cases.name: marker_zero_stack_round_trips_as_typed
roundtrip_cases.tsv:
VALUE	STACK	DESC	1H	MID	TOP
F	0	BASE FAIL 표시			
B	16	라이너	ADFE1H_01	MID1	TOP1
roundtrip_cases.$why: 🔴 U9 IN THE USER'S OWN MEDIUM. A '0' typed in Excel must come back as '0' - not blanked (marker folded into absence), not refused (marker still treated as invalid), not 'repaired'. The normal B row rides along so a serializer that special-cased markers by dropping columns would misalign it.

legacy_band_cases.$why: 🔴 `map_split_registry.bands` HOLDS REAL PLANS. legend 저장은 `replace_map`이므로, 읽지 못하면 그 맵을 여는 순간 화면이 비고 다음 편집 한 번이 계획을 **빈 집합으로 지운다**. 그래서 이 마이그레이션은 호의가 아니라 불변식이다. 아래 production 행들은 2026-07-28 라이브 DB(읽기 전용 조회)에서 읽은 실제 payload 형태다.

legacy_band_cases.name: production_single_band_becomes_mid_only
legacy_band_cases.$why: 🔴 한 구간이 스택 전체를 덮으면 그것은 '그 사이 전부'다. 1H로 넣으면 dt_map 계획이 1H만 있고 MID가 빈 행으로 보인다 — 같은 물리 구조를 다른 칸에 넣는 것이고, 사용자가 만든 적 없는 배치다.

legacy_band_cases.name: two_bands_at_stack_two_are_the_two_ends
legacy_band_cases.$why: The E-row, arriving from the old model. MID zone is 0 layers and stays empty - it must NOT be filled from one of the two ends.

legacy_band_cases.name: four_bands_cannot_be_expressed_and_are_REFUSED
legacy_band_cases.$why: 🔴 THE MOST IMPORTANT CASE IN THIS GROUP. Collapsing two middle bands into one MID changes the plan, and the save would then `replace_map` our lossy reading over the server's truth.

legacy_band_cases.name: unreadable_to_is_REFUSED_not_skipped
legacy_band_cases.$why: 🔴 `prevTo` SKIPS an unreadable `to` - correct for a panel that was still editing bands (show it, mark it, keep going), fatal for a migration. Skipping here silently shortens the stack.

legacy_band_cases.name: non_increasing_to_is_REFUSED
legacy_band_cases.$why: band_arithmetic's `non_increasing_inflates_the_next_band` shows the old model counted 25 layers for a 20-layer stack here. There is no honest zone reading of that.

legacy_band_cases.name: three_bands_where_the_first_is_not_layer_one_is_REFUSED
legacy_band_cases.$why: 1H is layer 1 exactly. A 3-layer first band is not a 1H, and forcing it into that cell would move two layers of material.
